source: Issue #81 controlled Azure/Megaport lab, 2026-11-13; no ARS in DUT.
evidence: Native CLI gateway/MSEE/ARS BGP output and two rounds of five ICMP requests classified by source eth0 versus decrypted vti81 ingress.
normalization: ASNs parsed from space- or hyphen-delimited native paths; redundant gateway instances deduplicated. No Azure resource IDs, public IPs, vault or provider account data.
limitations: Single shared circuit with one primary provider VXC; not redundant-path certification.
Forward ingress only; guest return routing is deliberately asymmetric.
Platform-internal iBGP copies are retained as observations, not modeled as independent transport advertisements.
LNG peerWeight is not modeled. The requested weight-100 experiment retained native weight 32768; configured-weight activation was not independently captured, so weight effects remain inconclusive.
